title: PixelKin - The Wakeful Fair (Buzzing)
_note: Seven cups in: the same tune at 144 with the heart going. Lead doubled an octave up on a thin pulse12, hats in sixteenths, the bass in eighths, a twitchy trill at the end of every fourth bar. Same 16 bars, same seam.
